map.肺癌 TNM 分期：按原发肿瘤 T、区域淋巴结 N、远处转移 M 组合确定 Ⅰ: Lung cancer TNM staging: T (primary tumor), N (regional nodes) and M (distant metastasis) combine to define stage I to IV; stage I/II is mainly surgical, stage III needs multidisciplinary assessment (resectable: surgery plus adjuvant; unresectable: concurrent chemoradiotherapy then immunotherapy consolidation), stage IV systemic therapy (targeted if driver-positive, immunotherapy if PD-L1 high, otherwise immunotherapy plus chemotherapy).
map.T3 — ＞5–7cm/胸壁/膈神经: T3 - >5-7 cm / chest wall / phrenic nerve
map.T4 — ＞7cm/纵隔/心脏/大血管: T4 - >7 cm / mediastinum / heart / great vessels
map.M1a — 对侧肺/胸膜/心包结节: M1a - contralateral lung / pleural / pericardial nodules
map.M1b — 单一器官单发转移: M1b - single metastasis in one organ
map.提示：本分期为解剖分期，需结合病理(非小细胞/小细胞)及分子分型(EGFR/AL: Note: this is anatomic staging; combine with pathology (non-small cell / small cell) and molecular typing (EGFR/ALK/ROS1/PD-L1) for individualized planning. Stage I-II prefers surgery, stage III needs multidisciplinary therapy (chemo/radio/immuno), stage IV is systemic therapy (targeted/immuno/chemo). Clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：肺癌 TNM 分期: 📚 Deep Dive: Lung Cancer TNM Staging
map.T2a(3–4cm)+N0+M0→ⅠB 期，首选手术切除+淋巴结清扫。: T2a (3-4 cm) + N0 + M0 -> stage IB; surgical resection with lymph node dissection preferred.
map.N3 无论 T→ⅢC 期，不可切除行同步放化疗+免疫巩固。: N3 regardless of T -> stage IIIC; unresectable cases get concurrent chemoradiotherapy plus immunotherapy consolidation.
map.M1a/M1b→ⅣA、M1c→ⅣB，以全身治疗为主。: M1a/M1b -> stage IVA, M1c -> stage IVB; systemic therapy is the mainstay.
map.分期驱动可切除性评估与辅助/新辅助策略。: Staging drives resectability assessment and adjuvant/neoadjuvant strategy.
